items.title: Cuauhtémoc Cárdenas
items.description: Cuauhtémoc Cárdenas Solórzano was a Mexican statesman and civil engineer. The son of President Lázaro Cárdenas (1934–1940), he was known for his contributions to Mexico's democracy and his 1988 presidential campaign. Cárdenas was regarded as one of the leading leftist figures in Mexico and in Latin America.

items.title: 2026 Toledo train collision
items.description: On 28 October 2026 at 08:54 CET (UTC+01:00), an AVE high-speed train collided end-on with a stationary Iryo high-speed train in Los Yébenes, Toledo, on the Madrid–Seville high-speed rail line, killing at least 69 people. Both trains involved in the crash were travelling from Atocha station in Madrid to Santa Justa station in Seville.
